og_title: The World Recalibrates Around Ji Ning’s Victory
og_description: News of Ji Ning’s duel spreads like wildfire, showing the dazzling impact of a Battle of Fame. See how friends, rivals, and a trapped Dao-companion react to his new power.
twitter_title: Ji Ning’s Victory Sends Shockwaves Through Commandery!
twitter_description: Ji Ning’s win over a Primal Daoist is the talk of the land! Beishan Baiwei cashes in, a rival seethes, and Nine Lotos is shocked. New chapter!

lore_anchors.definition: A pivotal fight in Xianxia where a rising cultivator clashes with an established powerhouse to a draw or forces a retreat, functionally announcing their arrival as a major figure regardless of the final kill.

One of the three Primal Daoist patriarchs of Snowdragon Mountain; after his duel with Ji Ning, he pragmatically accepted his role as a “stepping stone” and relocated his sect’s branch to avoid further conflict.
The heir of the Beishan Blacktiger Estate and Ji Ning’s close friend; a politically savvy noble who views his friendship with Ji Ning as a strategic investment that has now paid off handsomely.

The famous slovenly, fat youth recognized as the number one third-generation disciple of the Black-White College; he possesses a ruthlessly pragmatic Dao-heart that prioritizes self-improvement over internal competition.
A Black-White College disciple who views Ji Ning as a rival; his jealousy and resentment have festered into a Dao-heart demon that poisons his own spiritual progress.
Ji Ning’s master at the Black-White College; an Earth Immortal obsessed with the legacy of Immortal Beixing who quietly takes pride in his disciple’s growth.
A legendary nine-stance sword art created by Immortal Beixing; only the first six stances are publicly available in the Black-White College.
A trial formation set by the Dongyan Ancestor to test an heir’s Dao-heart by forcing them to confront their own heart. Nine Lotos has been trapped inside for nearly nine years.
The ancient, powerful clan that Nine Lotos belongs to; its hierarchical weight is so heavy that even a strong-willed heir like Nine Lotos feels compelled to submit to the Ancestor’s authority.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is a “Battle of Fame” in Xianxia?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A Battle of Fame is a pivotal duel where an underdog challenger fights a renowned expert to a stalemate or forces a tactical retreat, functionally announcing their power to the world—even without a kill. The fame itself becomes a shield and a ladder.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Chen Jin so angry?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Chen Jin has a festering Dao-heart demon born of jealousy toward Ji Ning. In Xianxia, such resentment is not just an emotion—it is a spiritual poison that can block cultivation progress and cause mental instability.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is the Sanpang Realperson not afraid of Ji Ning surpassing him?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Sanpang Realperson views his only rival as himself, a sign of a deeply cultivated, anti-ego Dao-heart. He understands that sect rankings are meaningless compared to the vast scale of the multiverse.
